process.title: How the Kianja marketplace works
process.subtitle: From the first contact to the final approval, every step is designed to ensure the project's success.
process.clientTrackTitle: From your need to the final delivery
process.studentTrackTitle: From your skills to your first income

s1.title: Post your need

s2.title: Receive applications
s2.detail: Compare students' profiles, portfolios and proposals.

s3.title: Choose your student
s3.detail: Select the candidate who best matches your technical requirements.

s4.detail: Communicate directly through the internal messaging to frame the work.

s5.title: Follow the progress

s1.detail: Enter your field of study, your specialty and your key skills.

s2.detail: Display ready-to-buy offerings or browse open missions.

s3.detail: Send your reasoned application with your rate and your deadline.

s4.title: Talk with the client
s4.detail: Clarify the specifications and agree on the expected deliverables.

s5.title: Do the work and deliver
s5.detail: Produce quality work and upload your deliverables to the platform.

s6.title: Build your reputation
s6.detail: Get a verified client review that boosts your reputation and your portfolio.

benefits.title: Why choose the Kianja marketplace?
benefits.subtitle: Students seeking experience, clients seeking expertise: a platform designed for mutual success.

talents.title: Qualified student talents
talents.text: Students trained to current standards, with validated skills and rated by their clients after each delivery.

budgets.title: Fair, adapted budgets
